svg.aria-label: Cardon Weavehouse DM build, 34 by 22 battle mat with two square outdoor strips at west and south, 32 by 20 building
svg.text: 2-SQUARE WEST + 2-SQUARE SOUTH OUTDOOR STRIPS PRESERVED • BUILDING 32 × 20 • 5 FT PER SQUARE
ROOMS: 21 Loading • 6 Storage • 15 Production • 11 Captain • 4 Finishing
Room 19: Jaroood at desk • Gargoyle as stone • Mimic as an upholstered chair • Elemental at night
Terrain: draw desk, cot, screen, 2 looms. No extra props needed. Outdoor areas are on the mat.
Workers can escape to either exterior strip; west loading and south public doors lead outside.
Use this map, not the older 34×22 all-building or 36×24 outdoor-strip versions.
